description: This PHP source file defines the MailingMatcherListener class, which listens to specific project and matcher-related events to send email notifications using predefined templates. It manages email notifications for project status changes and project publishing events within the Goteo platform, ensuring non-duplicate event creation and handling specific email workflows.

classes.name: MailingMatcherListener
classes.description: Listener class for project matcher events that sends email notifications based on project status and matcher events, ensuring no duplicate events and supporting multiple event types (matcher project updates, project publish).

methods.name: send
methods.description: Creates and fires a unique event to send email notifications for a project, preventing duplicate events and handling success or failure of email sending.

methods.name: onMatcherProject
methods.description: Handles matcher project events, generating and sending relevant notification emails depending on project status and user preferences.

methods.name: onProjectPublish
methods.description: Handles project publish events and triggers email notifications to relevant users if there are associated matchers pending or accepted.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers the event handlers for matcher project and project publish events for both application and console contexts.
